title: Single-Letterization of Rate-Cost Tradeoffs in Static Time-Invariant Control (STIC) Systems
summary: In settings such as online recommendation platforms, medical decision-making with interim summaries, and stochastic control with static plants, the underlying system is often static so that the next state depends only on the most recent action. Moreover, the true system state is high-dimensional and cannot be observed directly, so actions must be selected based on information received through a rate-limited communication link, which constrains the control performance.
